sections.title: Camera, movement and interpolation
items: Start with the notification among the currencies, then move the framing toward it while maintaining the panel’s readable orientation. Avoid a camera orbit that turns the words oblique at their most important moment.

Use separate curves for position, orientation and scale. An intermediate pose should not force a full stop unless the reference visibly pauses. Judge the projected silhouette and screen velocity, not just whether handles are Bézier.

sections.title: Lighting, materials and focus
items: Saturated purple/magenta studio treatment with warm diagonal light beams and soft bloom. Reconstruct with a separate low-frequency background gradient, colored area lights and controlled emissive beam planes; genuine volumetrics are an optional heavier alternative.
The glass panel picks up orange/purple color while preserving bright text. Use selective background defocus and broad reflections, not full transparency that lets light beams interfere with words.
Lighting descriptions name the visible treatment and an inferred reconstruction. Original light powers, lens, aperture, shutter and compositing settings are unknown unless explicitly recorded below.

sections.title: Construction controls and implementation order
items: Block the incoming and outgoing states first. Establish the main object trajectory, then schedule child actions and reading intervals. Add focus and exposure blur after the trajectory is intelligible. The following controls are a build plan, not measured source settings.

tables.caption: Native construction controls
rows: Control transmission/roughness and backing tint; reserve a stable text contrast zone.
Track panel center and projected width through the push; hold a readable target view.
Keep large foreground currencies off the key notification text.
Use source text only for study; do not assert this transaction occurred.

sections.title: Transitions, failure modes and review
items: A decisive change to a dark monochrome end card reduces complexity.
A screen-space blur on the entire composite makes the notification illegible. Render foreground panel and background separately when compositing control is needed.

Review this excerpt with both adjacent joins at normal speed, then diagnose at half speed. Check first-visible frames, accidental stops, silhouette clipping, text readability and outgoing blur. A contact sheet does not establish perceptual smoothness or audio quality.
